overview: Hidden Valley is a puzzle park in the woods just outside Launceston, and it’s a refreshingly different day out: instead of rides, you get trails of clues, brain-teasing missions and mysteries to solve as a team. It works for all ages, from children to grandparents.
Most of it is outdoors along woodland trails, but a few puzzle rooms and buildings are under cover, so it copes with a damp day if you’ve got coats and good shoes.

expect.title: Puzzle trails
expect.text: Follow the trails through the woods and work out the clues as you go, including a miniature village called Tremuddlewick.

expect.title: Indoor puzzles
expect.text: Find your way through the Forbidden Mansion, try to escape the Study, and play with perspective in an Ames room where people seem to shrink and grow.

expect.title: Play and extras
expect.text: There’s a play area called Tanglewood Hollow, a maze, a little train and gardens to relax in.

goodToKnow.label: Tickets
goodToKnow.text: Book ahead: it’s cheaper, numbers are limited and visitors without a booking can be turned away when it’s full. Arrival slots run from 10am to 2pm, and you can stay until 5pm.

goodToKnow.label: Return visits
goodToKnow.text: Return tickets can only be bought on the day of your visit.

goodToKnow.label: Food
goodToKnow.text: The Watering Hole Café sells pasties, sandwiches, jacket potatoes, cakes and ice creams to take away, open daily from 10am to 4.30pm.

goodToKnow.label: Dogs
goodToKnow.text: Welcome on the outdoor trails on a short fixed lead, but not in the Mansion, Study or on the train.

goodToKnow.label: Access
goodToKnow.text: Many paths are gravel, which can be hard going for wheelchairs and small mobility scooters.

goodToKnow.label: Parking
goodToKnow.text: Free, with plenty of space. It’s just off the A30/A395 near Launceston.

week.text: A clever choice for a family who like a challenge, and handy for your first or last day as it’s right by the A30. Arrive in the morning to give yourselves plenty of time for the puzzles.

pairWith.why: the nearest town for lunch and supplies

tips: Book an early arrival slot: last entry is 2pm and the puzzles take a while.
Bring coats and decent footwear if it’s been raining.

setting.note: Woodland puzzle trails plus indoor puzzle rooms

kids.note: Puzzles, a play area, a maze and a train
